edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as owner during Owned construction.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner to gate transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before rotating ownership.
onlyOwner gates the token rescue path transferAnyERC20Token.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] with the caller supplied amount.

approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].

The tokenAddress parameter directly becomes the external call target.
